description: Unit test class 'LDAPTestServiceTest' in the OrangeHRM project testing LDAP connection functionalities, including valid, invalid, anonymous connections, and various error scenarios.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class to verify LDAP connection handling, including success and various failure scenarios, using mock configurations and LDAP server fixtures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment, ensures server is configured and data is loaded before each test.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Sets up LDAP configuration mock, binds to LDAP, disables anonymous binding, sets server page size, and loads test LDAP users.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Verifies LDAP connection with valid settings.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests connection failure on anonymous bind attempt, expects ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidUserName
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with invalid username, expects InvalidCredentialsException.

methods.name: testInvalidUserNameSyntax
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with malformed DN, expects ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPassword
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with invalid password, expects InvalidCredentialsException.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection to a non-contactable host, expects ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with wrong port, expects ConnectionException.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection over SSL with wrong port, expects ConnectionException.
